capabilities: Fuzzy search open tabs by name, path, aliases, and tags
Switch to a tab from search results via command or hotkey
Load unloaded tabs on demand or at startup
extras: Warns that loading all tabs (via command or startup option) manipulates the DOM and may cause unexpected behavior; notes inactive tabs stay unloaded by default for performance.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search and switch among currently open tabs, which gets slow with many tabs open.
summary: Tab switcher that fuzzy-searches open tabs by file name, path, aliases, and tags to jump between them quickly.
